verdict.summary_en: Delivery note DN-261110-769 from Boise Semiconductor Inc. to Soony DC Hamburg, dated 11/10/2026, covering POs 4500318762 and 4500318766. It lists 41.200 PCS of CMP-GAM-001 (8 packages) and 5.000 PCS of CMP-GAM-002 (1 package). Total is 9 packages, 198 kg gross, carrier Alpen Air Cargo GmbH. Stamped received 13.11.2026 at DC-HAM and signed by Meyer K. There are no corrections or remarks.
red_flags: The note lists two POs but does not say which PO each line belongs to.
No ordered quantities are shown, so the delivered quantities cannot be checked against the POs from this document alone.
observations: Quantities are printed as '41.200' and '5.000' with a dot separator. I read them as thousands separators (41200 and 5000 PCS), which is the plausible reading for piece counts. The document does not state this.
Note date '11/10/2026' is ambiguous between US and German formats. I read it as 10 Nov 2026, in line with the DN number (261110) and the received stamp of 13.11.2026.
Blue received stamp with handwritten signature 'Meyer K.' is clear.
Package counts per line (8 + 1) match the stated total of 9.
